title: SSO login loops back to the sign-in page
summary: After the IdP certificate rotation, about 30% of Northwind users are redirected back to sign-in. Workaround: clear cookies. Blocks dispatchers at shift change.

title: Shipment export times out above 50k rows
summary: CSV export of the shipments view times out after 60 s on large accounts. Paginated export is in review.

title: Audit log export missing actor IP
summary: Exported audit logs omit the actor IP column that Acme's security review requires. Data exists in storage; export template drops it.

title: Robot fleet dashboard slow to load
summary: Fleet dashboard took 12 s to load. Fixed by caching the fleet summary query (release 26.9).

title: PHI field visible in notification email preview
summary: A patient reference number appeared in email previews. Hotfixed within 6 hours; incident report filed with the customer.

title: Request: US-only region pinning for backups
summary: Customer asks for contractual confirmation that backups never leave the US region. Engineering confirms current behavior; docs update pending.

title: Offline sync conflicts duplicate work orders
summary: When two remote sites edit the same work order offline, sync creates duplicates instead of merging. Fix targeted for release 26.12.

title: Admin console role editor resets on save
summary: Saving a custom role sometimes clears unchanged permissions. Reproducible on Firefox only.

title: Bulk user import rejects names with accents
summary: CSV import fails on non-ASCII characters in names. Workaround: import without accents and edit afterwards.

title: Large video attachments fail to upload
summary: Uploads above 2 GB fail at 99%. Multipart upload limit is misconfigured in the EU edge region.
